svg.title: Firefighter — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as firefighter, wearing a protective coat and a firefighter helmet. Visible work cue: A fire-hose nozzle emits two water strokes above a large open hose loop. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a firefighter helmet.
